g.text: TrendDetective (data-expansion @ 524818c) — Data contracts between the work areas
geometry: Point [lng, lat] or region bbox Polygon
bbox: [west, south, east, north] (zero-size for a point)
geojson: {type, id?, data: FeatureCollection, outline?, fillOpacity?, pointRadius?}
tools: {name: true} (no tool picker, all tools)
topics.<key>: one entry per topic and NOAA code ("temperature · maximum (TMAX)")
.station: {id, name, latitude, longitude, elevation, ★ source, distance_km} | null
.tools["Linear Regression"]: point: {slope, intercept, trend_line} · region: + p_value, CI, r²
map_layers: region → area-result + area-stations-<key> (dot colour = trend)
first, last, in_range, suggestion: [iso, iso] | null, stations[≤5]}
labels: DD.MM.YYYY, one per non-empty interval
region: anomaly average over stations + mean level
③ point flow: one per topic
③ region flow: stations in bbox
